From 7d124da53fdacc13f02ba4b3fe4597a352effe77 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Allen Winter <winter@kde.org>
Date: Sat, 30 Nov 2024 15:45:19 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] icaltypes.c - icalreqstattype_from_string don't allocate
 empty debug str

In icalreqstattype_from_string() don't allocate memory for an empty
status.debug string.

Fixes a fuzzer issue
---
 src/libical/icaltypes.c |  3 +-
 src/test/CMakeLists.txt |  1 +
 test-data/fuzz42536390  | 89 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 3 files changed, 91 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
 create mode 100644 test-data/fuzz42536390

diff --git a/src/libical/icaltypes.c b/src/libical/icaltypes.c
index 182ef1f..5f4cc1f 100644
--- a/src/libical/icaltypes.c
+++ b/src/libical/icaltypes.c
@@ -140,7 +140,7 @@ struct icalreqstattype icalreqstattype_from_string(const char *str)
      */
 
     p2 = strchr(p1 + 1, ';');
-    if (p2 != 0 && *p2 != 0) {
+    if (p2 != 0 && *p2 != 0 && *p2 != ';') { // skipping empty debug strings
         stat.debug = icalmemory_tmp_copy(p2 + 1);
     }
 
@@ -171,7 +171,6 @@ char *icalreqstattype_as_string_r(struct icalreqstattype stat)
     if (stat.debug != 0) {
         snprintf(temp, TMP_BUF_SIZE, "%d.%d;%s;%s", icalenum_reqstat_major(stat.code),
                  icalenum_reqstat_minor(stat.code), stat.desc, stat.debug);
-
     } else {
         snprintf(temp, TMP_BUF_SIZE, "%d.%d;%s", icalenum_reqstat_major(stat.code),
                  icalenum_reqstat_minor(stat.code), stat.desc);
diff --git a/src/test/CMakeLists.txt b/src/test/CMakeLists.txt
index 96b456d..0260659 100644
--- a/src/test/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/src/test/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -263,6 +263,7 @@ if(LIBICAL_BUILD_TESTING_BIGFUZZ)
     69527
     69888 # cpu timeout fails beyond 60s
     42536507 # cpu timeout fails beyond 60s
+    42536390
     usban
     usban2
     usban3
